Likewise Victor, Migo, Demetrius, Marcus, Flavianus, Vitalis, Dinalia, Clementia, Victoria, Felicia, Maxima, and Musta. Likewise Marcus, Honorius, Laurentius, Arbur, Crispinus, Tertius, Quintula, Restitutus, Revocatus, Paternus, Buttasius, Varicus, Paulus, Optatus, Spes, Valens, Donatus, Manilius, Petrus, Felix, and Proculus. Likewise Donatus, Gemella, Evantius, Lazarus, Venustus, Fluvinus, Rufinus, Crispinus, Naborus, Victorinus, Donatula, Victuris, Agutina, and Tertia, Mamerus. At Capua, the commemoration of Saints Cyprianus, Muscula, Donata, Novellus, Januarius, Silvanus, Plurianus, Saturus, and Julius. And elsewhere, Primus, Charius, Cyril, Macharius, Stilarus, [Col. 0451C] Venustus. Likewise Venustus, Julia, Felix, Verecunda, with nine others. Eocapus, Tertula, Antonia, Mustula, and Miginus. Likewise Donasta. And elsewhere, Euphemia, Macharius, Primus, and nine others. In the city of Vappingo, the deposition of Blessed Constantinus, bishop.

## 13 April

At Chalcedon, the commemoration of Saint Euphemia, and of Evapia and Secutor. And elsewhere, Januarius, Paulus, Passa, Carolus, Carita, Aroba, Azatonica, and Decimus. At Pergamum in Asia, Polycarp, bishop, and Paulus the deacon.

## 14 April

At Rome, on the Appian Way, in the cemetery of Praetextatus, the commemoration of Saints Tiburtius, Valerianus, Maximus, Cyriacus, Optatus, Pati, Saturninus, Martia, Frontina, Cornilia, Conditor, and Titulus. At Terni, Proculus, Valentinus, Pruusducus, Laurinus, Domnina the virgin with her fellow virgins, crowned together, and Saint Valerianus. And elsewhere, Optatus, Saturninus, Archelaus, Symphronius, Frontinus, Maximus, Decima, Martia, and Cornilia. At Alexandria, Fronto the monk.

## 15 April

In Picenum, on the Golden Mountain, Maro, Messor, Proclina, Mositis, and Jucundus. In Mesopotamia, Archelaus, Cyprianus, Comatus, Veronica, Acuta, and Diogenes the deacon with two brothers. At Antioch in Syria, Prosdocus, Veronica, and Dionina her daughter. Octavia, Potamia, Prudentius, Phocas, and Syrus. In Taudia of Galicia, Quoamalus, Archelaus, Potamus, and Donatella. In Spain, Caesaria, the martyrdom of Saints Lubercus and Apomides with two brothers, and Martianus. Likewise Martianus, Felix, Faustus, Fortunatus, Silvanus, and Lucianus. Gomali, Parcilai, Eonides, Mica, Gallienus, [Col. 0452A] Faustinus, Lucianus [lacuna], bishop and confessor, where the relics of Saint John the evangelist are buried. And the dedication of the altar of Saint Julianus the martyr, who suffered at Brioude.

## 16 April

In Achaea, in the city of Corinth, the commemoration of Saints Caelestis, Carissus, Leonidas, Lota, Tertia, Christiana, Galla, Theodorus, Carissus, all drowned at sea; Caritonus, Caelesta with others; Unica, Gallinia, Monicia, and Nigia. And elsewhere, Martianus, Enianus, Felix, Hermogenes, Vincentius, Tertius, and Caelestis. In Mauretania, the commemoration of Basilia. In Pontus, Insclacellus, Martialis, Felix, Fortunatus, Silvanus, Lucianus, Goamalus, Parcilai, Leonidas, Mica, Gallienus, Martianus, Faustinus, and Lucianus, Jucundus.

## 17 April

At Antioch, the commemoration of Saint Peter [Col. 0452B] the deacon and Hermogenes the minister, Peter, Fortunatus, and Martianus. In Africa, Burucus, Quintus, Mappalicus, Victuricus, Donatus, Januarius, Macor, Gallus, Theodorus, Julianus the presbyter, and Meconius, Miginus, Diomedes, and Philippianus.

## 18 April

In the city of Salona, the commemoration of Saints Septimus the deacon and Victuricus. And elsewhere, Hermogenes and Dionysius. In Africa, Victor, Pamphilus, Donatus, Januarius, Micio, Domnus, Tureminus, Syricus, Priscianus, and Jucundus. At Rome, Saints Eleutherius and Anthia his mother, Parthenius, Colocerus, Phoebus, Proculus, Apollonius, Fortunatus, Crispinus, Expeditus, Mappalicus, Victurinus, and Gagius. At Auxerre in Gaul, the dedication of the altar of the older church.

## 19 April

In the city of Militana in Armenia, Hermogenes, [Col. 0452C] Gaius, Rufus, Expeditus, Aristonichus, and Galata, crowned on one day. At Militene in Armenia, Rufus, Hilarius, Aristonichus, Fortunatus, Donatus, Gagius, and Majulinus. In Africa, Serecianus, Donatus, and Heladius. Likewise Serecianus and Hermogenes with two others. At Gaucoliber, the commemoration of Saint Vincentius.

## 20 April

In Africa, the commemoration of Saints Servianus, Arajacus, Silvanianus, Fortunatus, John, Oracius, Donatus, Martia, Gema, Cornelia, Gemina, Cornilia, Fortunatus, and Vincentia. At Rome, the deposition of Saint Victor, bishop, Felix, Alexander, and Papias. At Verdun, the deposition of Saint Marcellinus, bishop and confessor, Silvanus, Cyriacus, Donatus, and Quintus. In the city of Auxerre, the deposition of Saint Martinus, presbyter and confessor.

## 21 April

At Alexandria, the commemoration of Saints Fortunatus, Arator the presbyter, Felix his son, and Vitalis, who rests in prison. At Rome, in the cemetery of Callistus on the Appian Way, the commemoration of Saints Valerianus, Maximus, Tiburtius, and Donatus. And at Terracina in Campania, the commemoration of Saint Amphelicus and Jucundus. And elsewhere, Victor, Papias, and Felix. And elsewhere, the deposition of Aprunculus, bishop.

## 22 April

In Africa, Silvanus. In the city of Hierapolis, the commemoration of Saint Philip the apostle. At Rome, in the cemetery of Callistus on the Appian Way, the deposition of Gaius the pope and Primolus Tierdianus. At Lyon in Gaul, the martyrdom of Saint Epolidius. And elsewhere, Leonidas, Arator, Cyriacus, and Basilia. In the city of Sens, the deposition of Leo, bishop.

## 23 April

In Africa, the commemoration of Saints Catulinus, [Col. 0453A] Saturninus, Ghorus, Felix, Theona, Theodorus, Victorinus, Venustus, Victor, Naborus, Solutus, Plenus, Silvius, Felix, Vitalis, Theodorus, Faustinus, Valerius, and Ursus. At Rome, Naborus. Likewise Silvius. Likewise Vitalis. Likewise Felix and Nonna. At Alexandria, Corona. In the city of Valence in Gaul, the commemoration of Felix the presbyter, Fortunatus the deacon, Achilleus the deacon, and the commemoration of George the martyr.

### 24 April

In Alexandria: the feast of the holy virgin Corona, Victor, Zoticia, Fortunus, Donatus, Felix, Saturninus, Secundus, and Silvianus. Also Silvianus, Rufina, Liberalis, Meturius, Tonitus, Firianus, Barachus, Nabor, Fuscus, Naventius, Saranus, and Fortunus. Also Donatus, Florianus, and the presbyter Theon. In Africa: the feast of the holy Faustinianus, Victurinus, Salunus, [Col. 0453B] Theona, Valeria, Fortunus, Publius, Forianus, Memmerus, Faustus, Martia, Saubacia, Theudestia, Valerianus, Urbanus, Herus, Lucius, and Victuris.

On this day also, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego—under their alternative names Ananias, Azarias, and Misahel—were delivered from the blazing fire in Babylonia: blessed be God.

At Lyon in Gaul: the passion of the holy Alexander and thirty-four others; and the dedication of the crypt where their bodies rest.

### 25 April

In the city of Syracuse in Sicily: the feast of the holy Evodius and Hermogenes; the passion of Saint George and Calesta. In Africa: Nubilis, Marca, Hermenphus, Fortunus, and Jucundus. At Lyon: the burial of Blessed Rusticus, bishop. The Greater Litania.

### 26 April

At Axiopolis: Aurelius. At Antioch: Leonides, Vendeus, and Marius. In Africa: Julius, Victuris, Syricus, Honoratus, Felix, Paulus, Maximus, Victor, Simplicius, Pollio, Vitus, Calendinus, Apollonius, Martiana, Felicissima, and Hernia; Martianus, Lictissimus, Fimia, Felix, Germanus, Felicia, Evasia, and Gemellina with their companions; Silvanus. At the monastery of Centulum in Gaul: the burial of Saint Richarius.

### 27 April

In the city of Tarsus in Cilicia: the feast of Saint Castor and Germanus. At Nicomedia: Anthimus, bishop; Stephanus, bishop; Antonius, presbyter. In Lydia: Genesius, Sodalis, Zotica, Marinus, Zeto, Helpidius, Eutychius, and Lupicinus. In Armenia, in the city of Militene: Heremites, Helpidius, Eppeius the presbyter, and Hermogenes. And elsewhere: Maurus; the captive deacon; Husandus, Prianius, and Cyprianus.

In Egypt, at Nicomedia: Victor, Maximus, [Col. 0453D] Martianus, Paulus, Germanus with six others, Gemellina, Lactissima, Felicia, Germana, Felix, Evantia, Victurinus, Nicophorus, Dioscorus, Papias, Serapion, John, and Julius. At Antioch: Thimia, Maurus, Arius the deacon, Genonsus, and Sodalis.

### 28 April

In Pannonia: Eusebius, bishop, and Vitalis and Pollio. In Alexandria: Victorinus. At Tarsus in Cilicia: Malina with 170 others, [Col. 0454A] Aphrosia, Carilippus the presbyter, Agapius the reader, and Eusebius the eunuch.

[Note: Agapius. Although no one should expect us to remove all, or even most, of the errors with which this Martyrology is disfigured, nevertheless we do not wish to miss any opportunity, whenever it presents itself, of pointing out something that may benefit the reader. Accordingly, we note here that Acherius was mistaken when he invented two saints, one called “Lectures” and the other “Eunuchus.” For the author of the Martyrology observed that Carilippus was a presbyter, Agapius a reader, and Eusebius a eunuch. Read immediately: “of the province of Numidia.”]

In Africa, in the province of Diomedia: the feast of the holy Manilius, Donatus, Maurilus, Lucianus, Victorinus, the virgin Nicia, and 283 others. In the city of Betoriva: the burial of Saint Eusebius the presbyter.

### 29 April

In Alexandria: the feast of Saint Germanus the presbyter and Prosducus the deacon. At Nicomedia: Prudentius, Martialis, Sabatius, Eudomon, and Barelius. Also Germanus, Filicosus, Budentius, Urbanus, and Pigata; Silvanus and Jocus. In Africa: Gtactus and six other martyrs. At Perusia in Tuscany: Valentinus, Martianus, Bononus, Vitalis, Augustus, Victurinus, Manilius, Metrona the virgin, Maculus, and Meginus. In Alexandria: Pudens, Martianus, Filocosa, Theodosia the virgin, and Padis with two others.

### 30 April

In Alexandria: Dorotheus the presbyter, Rodocianus the deacon, Victor, Terentius, Martinus, and Majorica. Also Victor, Claudius, Silvanus, Demetrius, Julius, Secundinus the bishop, Meritus, and Honorius. Also Silvanus, Saturninus, Affiodus, Dugdius, Pastor the bishop, Secundianus, Concordia, Marianus, James, Florianus, Gabriel, Gaianus, Postumus, Mominus, Quintianus, Cassius, Fasilius, Florentius, Demetrius, Gadudius, and Crispinus. Also Crispinus, Donatus, Zeno, Pomodianus the deacon with 24 others, Secundianus the bishop, Alexander the deacon, Bubatus, Saturus, Diotrus, Ropodianus, and Nomensis.

At Rome: the burial of Quirinus and Secundinus. At Aphrodisias: Rodocianus the deacon, Terentius, Marinus the presbyter, Dagarius with twelve others, Meturius, Clement, [Col. 0454C] Lucinus, Telesphorus, Primus, Saturninus, Emilianus, Majorica, Saturninus, and the burial of Polochronius the bishop.

## The Month of May

It has 31 days.

### 1 May

The beginning of the preaching of our Lord Jesus Christ.

In Asia, at Hierapolis: the feast of the holy Apostles Philip and James; Quintianus, Heleotherus, Gaius, Alexander, and Saturninus. And elsewhere: Apollonius and Euphemius. At Interamna, at the sixty-fourth milestone: Proculus, Pelestius, Agapitus, and 33 soldiers; and the feast of Matthew and James the apostles. In the East: Quintinus. In Jerusalem: the feast of Saint Judas, also called Quiriacus, bishop. At Mérida: the feast of Saint Saturninus. At Toulouse: the feast of Orientius, bishop. At Auxerre: the burial of [Col. 0454D] Saint Amator, bishop. In the city of Bigorra: the burial of Saint Justin, the great bishop; Isicius and Phocus. In the city of Amiens: the feast of the holy martyrs Agius and Aciolus. At Agaunum: the passion of King Sigismund.

### 2 May

Germanus, Celestinus, Felix, Cettinus, Urbanus, and Privatus. In Alexandria: Saturninus with his companion Eopolus. In the Armenian city of Militene: Helpidius, Hermogenes, and Lupus. In Alexandria: Germanus, Celestinus, [Col. 0455A] and Sanctinus. At Auxerre: the translation of the bodies of the holy confessors Optatus the bishop, Memorius the presbyter, and Sanctinus the presbyter.

### 3 May

In Jerusalem: the discovery by Queen Helena of the holy cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, 233 years after the Passion of the Lord, during the reign of the emperor Constantine; the city was illuminated. Also the feast of Saint Hermogenes.

At Rome: the feast of Saint Eventius, Alexander, Theodolus, and Fortunatus; the feast of Arbonus. In Africa: Marianus, Saturninus, Rufina, Fortunio, and Fortunatus. At Auxerre: the translation of the bodies of the holy confessors Eusebius the presbyter and Avitus the deacon.

### 4 May

At Nicomedia: Antonia and Justus. In Africa: the feast of Celestinus, Felix, Urbanus, Romanus, [Col. 0455B] Bellicus, Martialis, Mittunus the presbyter, Florianus, and Peter. And elsewhere: Loguorgue. At Caesarea: the feast of Saint Silvinus and Vibianus. In Alexandria: the forty martyrs, Nestor, Mitton, and Antoninus. At Auxerre: the burial and translation of the body of Saint Corcodemus, deacon and confessor, in the basilica of Saint Amator.

### 5 May

Eutychius the deacon and martyr. At Thessalonica: the feast of Saint Herenaeus, Peregrinus, and Herena. In Africa: Gregorius, Arcelaius, Felicissima, and the passion of Saint Tryphon. In Alexandria: Petivius. At Vienne: the burial of Nectarius and Nicetius, bishops. At Auxerre: the passion of Saint Juvinianus the reader. At Arles: the burial of Saint Hilary, bishop.

### 6 May

The feast of Saint John the apostle and evangelist, who was thrown before the Latin Gate into a cauldron of boiling oil. In Persia: the feast of Saint Matthew the apostle and evangelist. In the city of Galatia: the feast of the most blessed Gerontius the confessor. In Africa: the feast of Secundianus the bishop, James, Marianus, Concordia, Marina, Heliodorus, Saturninus, and Silvanus.

At Milan: Victor and Felix. Also Victor, Carica, Aufidia, Judith, and Emeria. Also Victor, Acuta, Faustinus, Helariana, Victurianus, Saturninus, Gavinus, Aedentius, Fortunatus, Victoria, Primus, Gaianus, and Valentina; Portumius, Justinus, Majoricus, Venustus, Massus, Processa, Secundianus, Inportunus, Quintianus, Peter, Tassicassiricus, Veneria, Bonifacia, Quintus, Florinus, Victorinus, Memoria, and Gaudula. Also Victorinus, Crispinus, Possinna, Labor, and Massila. Also Haianus, Faserus, Maxentius, Nina, Virtunia, Valeria, Tironius, [Col. 0455D] Matrona, and Citinus with their companions and the remaining saints.

At Florio: Herenaeus, Fortunatus, Faustinus, Gavinus, Herentius, Pappalicus, Primus, Cassius, Secundus, Celerinus, Jeremiah, Flavius, and Gaianus with twenty others. At Magropus: Marcellinus, Maximus, Bafrofita, Augustianus, Nicetius, with 76 others. Also Gaianus with 72 other martyrs. At Auxerre: the burial of Saint Valerius, bishop.

### 7 May

At Nicomedia: the feast of Flavius the bishop and Augustinus the bishop. Also Augustinus. The three brothers Marcellinus, Macrobius, and Eutychius. In Africa: Celerinus, Maximus, Victurius the bishop, Pontenella, and many others. Also Augustinus, Gaianus, Victurius, Maximus, Celerinus, Frontinus, Quintus, Flavia, Martialis, Privatianus, Septimina, Dexter, Quinta, Ornesius, Donatus, and Octavianus. Also Donatus, Marianus, Navigius, Pulverius, Rogata, Victor, Secundus, Caecilius, Donata, Saturninus. Also Donatus, Julius, Navida, Felix, Fortunatus, Crescentius, Sapius, Rogatianus, Donatus, Gallicus, Justinianus, Vitalicus, Rogatianus, Donatus, Gallicus, Lucella, Honoratus, Felicia, Savina, Saltus, Simplicius, Flavia, Alexius, Catula, Januaria, Eutycia, Victoria, Peculiaris, Germanus, Ercola, Rogata, Marcella, Odemarus; Avida, Saturnina, Felix, Victurius, Processus, Promolus, Donata, Castula, Secundianus, Donata, Martialis, Rogata, Fortunatus, Tunida, Crescentius, Germanus, Victoria, Palatinus, Epaphroditus, [Col. 0456B] Marcellinus, Floridianus, and Faustinus the bishop. Also Eutychius with 45 others.

In the city of Diospolis: the passion of Saint George. At Autun: the burial of Blessed Placidus the presbyter.

### 8 May

At Milan: Victor, Eutychius, [lacuna]atia, Fortunatus, and Saturninus. At Constantinople: Agathus the soldier and Maximus the presbyter. Antis the deacon, Arestinus, Marinus, Tampus, Victoria, Stertia, Agatha, Florida, Lucius, Donatus, Victuris, Flavia, John, Nina, Castus, Gaius, Forus, Maximus, Felix, Martianus; Famosa, Honesta, Niger, Baptizius, Rusticus, Processus, Secundus, Militus, Felicia, Maxima, Dativa, Tuiana, Secundola, Dativa, Gundinus, Tertulus, Celestinus, Faustinus, and Januarius.

Also Victuris, Zetula, Sciala, Fortunus, Rogatus, Faustinus, Canerius, Barachus, and Siddinus. Also Nina, Tidius, Mittunus, Syricus, Rogatus, Donata, and Bacchus. Also Gadderus, Breurus, Donata, Spica, Rogatus, Saturninus, Gaudiosa, Vitalis, Cecilia, Galla, Januaria, Senerus, Rogatus, Matronica, Augusticia, Saturninus, Rufus, Faustinus, Victor, Cittinus, Zaderus, and Antiquus. Also Nina and Saturus.

In Egypt: Victor, Stephanus, and Januarius. At Sanconicum: the burial of Saint Martin and Julianus. At Auxerre: the burial of Heladius, bishop. At the monastery of Corbie: the translation of the body of Saint Gentianus the martyr.

### 9 May

At Axiopolis: Quirillus, Quindeus, and Zeno. At Tarsus in Cilicia: Aphrodisius, Jucundus, and Firmus. At Milan: the apostles John, Andrew, and Thomas, in the basilica by the Roman Gate. In Persia: 310 martyrs. At Constantinople: the feast of Saint Timothy. At Rome, on the Via Latina: Gordianus and Primulus; the feast of Blessed Beatus the confessor.

[Note: Axiopolis. Acherius had turned Axiopolis, a city of Moesia, into the martyr Axiopolus.]

### 10 May

At Rome, on the Via Latina, in the cemetery of the same name: the feast of Gordianus and Julius. In the cemetery of Praetextatus at Rome: the feast of Saint Epimachus, Major the confessor, Quartus, Quintus, Probata, Moeca, Peter, Januarius, Fortunio, Thecla, Axiopolis, [Note: Axiopolis. Acherius had turned Axiopolis, a city of Moesia, into the martyr Axiopolus.] Cyril, Cendis, Dionysius, Accisus, Crispionius, Zeno, Aphrodisius, Privatus, Giddinus, Peter, Saturninus, Dativus, Fortunus, Lucellea, Maxima, Mattona, Mutacius, Cicilius, Victurius, Januarius, Sacusa, Bonosa, Victurina, Majulus, Constantia, Maxima, Januarius, Geminius, Saminus, Peregrina, Erius, Senterus, Marullus, Felix, Indicus, [Col. 0457A] Reflentius, Tinnius, Felio, Tuintus, Seleucus, Zetula, Januaria, Fortunatus, Tedetia, Tonatus, Rogata, Paulina, Januarius, Nina, Honorius, Candedia, Secundus, Saturninus, Donatus, Salvator, Felix, Marcus, Nappolus, Coddeus, Datus, Naso, Moses, Satulus, Victuris, Masutus, Malchus, Severus, Martianus, Fortunus, Saturus, Quintalis, Fidelis, Severiolus, Quintus, Faustus, Donatus, Excruatus, Biricus, Septimus, Lucinus, Restitutus, Dativus, Januaria, Nina, Felix, Satica, Marcella, Tula, Matrona, Lucusa, Victoria, Felicia, Jucunda, Gloriosa, Rogatina, Victurina, Julia, Prima, Fortunatus, Maria, Rogata, Monnus, James, Septimia, Maurellus, Incidus, Tunius, Felicio, Seleucus, Honoratus, Saturnus, Lucinus, Zeberia, Venustus, Saturninus, and Quintula.

Also Cyril and Dionysius. And elsewhere: the burial of Juvenalis and the prophet Job.

### 11 May

In Sirmium: the feast of Saint Montanus. In Africa: Majulus, Victorinus, Fortunatus, Septimus, Julius, Crispus, Januaria, Primulus, Manilius, and Nereus. Also Manilius, Victoria, Fortunatus, Januarius, Jucundus, Syppianus, and Epiminus. On the Via Salaria, at the twenty-second milestone: the feast of Saint Anthimus. In Asia: the feast of Demetrius and Thaddeus, and the burial of Nepotianus. At Vienne: the burial of Mamertus and Mamertinus, bishops.

### 12 May

At Rome: the feast of the holy brothers Nereus and Achilleus. And elsewhere: the feast of Saint Pancratius; Gratus and Soteris the virgin; John; Achilles; Moses; Aphroditus with 504 others, whose names God knows; Alexander, Moisites, and Julius. In Africa: Prancatius.

### 13 May

In Alexandria: the feast of Aphrodisius, Agrippa, Sabinus, Gryphus, Lucius, Cyrilla, Cridula, and Juvinus with two others. At the port of Trajectum in Gaul: the burial of Saint Servatius, bishop and confessor. In Palestine: Taracus, Probus, and Andronicus. At Polentia: the passion of Saint Victor and Saturninus. In Alexandria: Agrippa, Verus, Cyril, Sabinus, Maximus, Credulus, and Gagius, and the burial of Sebastianus the bishop. In the city of Auxerre: the burial and translation of Saint Marcellianus, bishop.

### 14 May

In Syria: Victor and Corona, who suffered together. In Africa: the feast of Secundianus, Quartus, Victorianus, Januarius, Medion, Alexander, Afranianus, Maximinus, Proculus, Audactus, and Adeodatus. In Asia: Saint Maximinus. At Milan: Victor, [Col. 0457D] Timor, Felix, Rusticus, and 304 holy martyrs who suffered with Saint Cyriacus. At Clermont: the dedication of the church of Saint Agricola.

### 15 May

In Sirmium: Timothy; and elsewhere: seven virgins, Alexander, Digna, and Chr[lacuna]. In Sardinia: Simplicius. At the Roman port: Praestabilis, Victor, Cyricus, Janus, and Heraclius. At Milan: Victor. At Lampsacus: the passion of the holy Peter and Andrew, Paul, Dionysius, and Julius. At Autun: Reticius, bishop.

### 16 May

In Isauria: the holy Aquilinus, Victorianus, Heraclius, Paulinus, and Minervus. In the city of Picenum: Ausomus, Florentius, Diocletianus, Memmius, and Justus. In the city of Ephesus: Mengenes, Gaianus, and Juvinus. In the city of Corthosa: Vincentius, Niderunus, Herelius, Paulus, Minervus, and Aquila. Also Paulus, Monorgus, and Gaius.

At Auxerre, in the village of Caiacum: the passion of Saint Peregrinus, the first bishop of that city. At Troyes: the passion of Saint Fidolus, presbyter and confessor.

### 17 May

In Alexandria: Victor, Basilia, and Silvanus. At Rome: Parthenius, Gallicorus, Eponus, and Liberius the bishop. At Nevers: Heraclius, Paulus, Minerius, Agulinus, Victor, Artemius, and Calcorius.

### 18 May

In Alexandria: Potamon the presbyter, Hortasius, Serapion, Panterus, Dioscorus, Pamius, Pentecon the deacon, Cenron, Dativus, Lucius, Maxima, and Hermon the reader with four other martyrs. In Egypt: Dioscorus the reader, who suffered much. At Constantinople: Effucius, Serapion, Bustasius the presbyter, Patamon, Panterus, Peteclondus, Eran the reader, Dativus, Martianus, Luciosus, Luciana, and Egina. And elsewhere: the feast of Cassius, Victor, and Julianus.

### 19 May

At Rome: the feast of the holy eunuchs Calocerus and Parthenius and their wives. They were killed under the emperor Decius and rest in the cemetery beside the Appian Way. In the cemetery of Callistus on the Appian Way: Paternus, Gallicorus, Indus, Seleucus, Felix, Elonicus, Christus, Calonica, and Julia. Also Urbanus, Ingenua, and Saturnus.

In Alexandria: the feast of Arenus the deacon. At Caesarea in Cappadocia: the feast of Poliochus. In Africa: the feast of Quintus, Primulus, Salustus, Fortunatus, two Donati, Primus, Indica, Lugusta, Rogata, Urbana, and Romana. In Getulia: the feast of Emilius, Basilus, Praetextata, Basilia, and Parthimius.

### 20 May

In Africa: the feast of Victoria, Marcellosa, and Salsa. At Rome, on the Via Salaria: Basilissa, Aureus, Nustia, Nemavius, and Baudelus the martyr. And elsewhere: the feast of the holy brothers Gervasius and Protasius, and the burial of Vellesius and Faustus, bishops.

### 21 May

In Mauretania: Timothy, Polus, and Eutychius the deacon. In the province of Caesarea: Epolus, Eutychius, and Jucundus. In Africa: the feast of Maurella, Quintus, Primulus, Salustus, Fortunatus, Nirilla, and Primus. At Caesarea in Cappadocia: Polyeuctus, Victurius, Donatus, and Quintus. In Britain: the feast of Timothy the deacon. And elsewhere: Matthew the apostle. In the city of Auxerre: the burial of Blessed Valens, presbyter and confessor.

### 22 May

At Rome: the feast of Faustinus, Timothy, Venustus, Castus, Aemilius, Gotto, Rogatus, Maxentius, Felix, Januarius, Concessus, Albinus, and Rogatianus. Also Castus. Also Plassus. On the island of Corsica: the passion of Saint Julia the virgin and martyr. At Caesarea in Cappadocia: the feast of Saint Polioctus.

### 23 May

In Spain: the feast of Epictetus, Aptonius, and Basil the bishop. Also Aptonius and Jucundus. In Africa: Quintus, Lucius, and the passion of Saint Desiderius the bishop; Julianus, Felix, Montana, Januaria, Emilia, Nonna, Alemeris, Astius, Basileus the bishop, Victurius, Firmus, Montanus, Julianus, Victuricus, Fidelis, Donatus, Nicia, Faustus, Timothy, Silvanus, and Phocus. In the city of Auxerre: the burial and translation of Saint Helena the virgin.

### 24 May

In Istria: the feast of Zebellus, Servulus, and Secundinus. In Africa: the feast of Saturninus and six other martyrs. At the Roman port: the feast of Vincentius. In Syria: Zoelus, Saturus, Timinus, Saturninus, Servilus, Felix, Silvanus, and Fortunus. Also Zoelus, Stria, Diocles, and Maximinus. In Gaul, in the city of Nantes: the feast of the holy brothers Rogatianus and Donatianus.

### 25 May

In the Tuscan territory, in the city of Blera: the feast of Sententiata, Vincentius, and Saint Juliana. At Milan: the burial of Dionysius the bishop, Polegratus, and the four other crowned martyrs Vincentius, John, and Marius. In the East: Eusebius. On the Via Nomentana, at the ninth milestone: the feast of Urbanus the bishop. In the cemetery of Praetextatus: Dorostolus. In Africa: Fabianus, Septimus, and Julius. At Ephesus: John the apostle and Saturninus. At Tomis: Victurius, Istialis, Victuria, Flavius, and the burial of Saint Marcellus.

### 26 May

The feast of Heraclius, Paulus, Mindina, and Jucundus. In Africa: also Paulus, Anteon, Quadratus, Rufinus, Valeria, and Magnus. In the Tuscan city: the feast of Felicissimus, Heraclius, Paulinus, Menedina, Saturus, Victurius, Saturninus, and Maurinus. Also Saturus, Fortunatus, and Thomedius. In the territory of Auxerre, at the place called Quotiacum: the passion of Saint Priscus the martyr with an innumerable multitude.

### 27 May

In Alexandria: the feast of Aquila the presbyter, of the Gospel, and fourteen others. At Tomis: Elias, Lucianus, Zotichus, Martialis, Victurius, and Maurina; Servulus. In Africa: the feast of Saccus, Julius, Vaama, and Carpia. In Sardinia: Salutianus, Eutricus, Crescentinus, Titianus, Quintus, and Stabulus.

### 28 May

In Pamphylia: Zetulus, Primus, Nonnus, Euresius, and Julius. In Africa: Portunius, Ariminia, and Secundinus. [Col. 0459C] In Sardinia: Aemilius, Felix, Primianus, Lucianus, Jucundianus, and Lucius.

At Rome, on the Via Nomentana, at the thirteenth milestone: the feast of Epicatus, Eustasius, Victia, and Castula. Also Epicatus, Octubrius, Uroria, Vippiapilus, Hominus, Marcellus, Ciconia, Maximus, Philominus, Avicia, Commienus, Martianus, Fluminus, Marianus, and Castula with nine others. In the city of Paris: the burial of Saint Germanus, bishop and confessor.

### 29 May

At Cibalae: the feast of Saint Pollio the reader and martyr. At Nicomedia: Saint Cyril. In Africa: the feast of Primus, Aaccidia, Passimon, and 153 others. At Trier: the burial of Maximinus, one of the ancient bishops. At Rome, on the Via Aurelia: the feast of Saint Restitutus the martyr. On the Via Tiburtina: the seven brothers. In Spain: [Col. 0459D] the feast of Saint Gentius. At Antioch: Sicimodus, Bassus, Venustus, Victurius, and Pullienus. At Caesarea in Cappadocia: Carellus, Primulus, Finodus, Venustus, Tredenteus, and Jucundus. In Anaunia: Sisinnius and Alexander the martyr. At Rome: the feast of Saint Petronilla, Alexander, and Martyrius.

### 30 May

At Antioch: the feast of Sici and Palatinus. At Cagliari in Sardinia: the feast of Gabinus and Crispolus. At Nicomedia: the feast of many saints.

### 31 May

At Aquileia: the feast of Cantius, Cantianus, Protus, Chrysogonus, and Cantianilla. At Carthage: Daciana. At Cagliari in Sardinia: Crescentianus and Memmius.

[Note: Cagliari. Read “Calaris.”]

In the city of Syrta: Dacianus. At Rome, on the Via Aurelia: the feast of Processus, Martinianus, and Firminus. The feast of Gaulienus, Germanus, Victurius, Silvanus, Telesphorus, Victurinus, Donatus, Istialis, Tertius, and Rogatus. Also Germanus. Also Silvanus, Honorius, Cilicia, and Tertulla. Lanta, Victoria, Fortunatus, Maxima, Rogata, Paulicia, Agapia, Castula, and Amella. Also Tertulla, Lupus, Justus, Thecla, and Firmus. At Antioch: Paulinus and Isicius.

## The Month of June

It has 30 days.

### 1 June

The Litania is to be proclaimed.

At Thessalonica: Octavius. [Col. 0460B] At Antioch: Zosimus and the virgin Thecla. In Africa: Crispinus. At Rome: Juvencus, Cyriacus, Nicomedes the martyr, Exuperantius, and Heraclia.

At Thessalonica: Lucia the virgin and Auceia, the barbarian king; Rogatus, Germanus, Silvanus, Bullodus, Cecilia, Tertullus, Lanta, Victoria, Gaius, Fortunatus, Maximus, Rogata, Paulina, Agapia, Castula, Coteusa, Novella, Agapa, Carra, Uraria, Bublasa, Fortunatus, Martinus, Saturninus, Baianus, Rogatianus, and Honoratus.

Also Martianus, Saturninus, Pontinus, Paulus, Petronius, Rutilia, Quietia, Januaria, and Novellus. Also Januaria, Sosia, Fedosa, Victurina, Matrona, Castula, Rogatianus, Quintus, Marcus, and Gemina. Also Paulus, Martialis, Mitunus, Vericus, and Cassius. Also Saturninus and Felix. Also Martianus. Also [lacuna], Rogatus, and Jannis. Also Fortunatus, Martianus, Saulus, and Castus. Also Januarius, Donatus, [Col. 0460C] and Hortensius. Also Saturninus, Martinus, Malchus, Silvanus, Quintus, Felicia, and Sillesa. Also Januaria, Fortunata, Victoria, Maria, Prima, Gemellina, and Faustinus. Also Novella, Donatella, Getulus, Baricus, Urbanus, Romanus, Primia, and Tertulla. Also Casta and Maxima. Also Orbanius, Optata, Matrona, Melosa, Metunus, Melosus, Secundus, and Gemellina. Also Urbanus, Saturninus, Julius, Surdida, Silvana, Rufina, Nina, Sepacius, Vincentius, Priscus, Hilary, Felix, Castula, Arabus, Publius with 120 others; Lupus with twelve others; Catulinus, [lacuna], Blosius, Martianus, Haianus, Marcellianus, and Fledius. Also Marcellianus, Castus, Marcus, Major, Proculus, Pagatus, Tertius, Silissa, Festula, Majosa, Timothy, Marcellina, Rutilus, Germanus, and John with ninety others.

At Vienne: Claudius, bishop.

### 2 June

At Rome: Marcellinus the presbyter and Peter the exorcist; and Marcellinus the presbyter, Tomatus, Rogatus with 42 others, Secundus, Maxima, Martianus, Silvinus, Flavianus, Paulus, Peter, Victoria, Matrona, Fausta, Extricata, Antonina, Saturnina, Donata, Reducta, and Maxima.

Also Saturninus, Paulus, Julia, Florentinus, Fortunatus, Maxima, Urbana, Felicissima, Justa, Flavia, Matrona, Martia, Valentina, Fortunatus, Venusta, Donata, Maria, Gallica, Tertulla, Vatalica, and Evantius. Also Julia, Sammata, and Possinna. Also Saturnina and Concordia. Also Donata, Felix, [Col. 0461A] Valentinus, Januaria, Mastilla, and Lucius. Also Martha, Marcella, Proculus, Datula, Victoria, and Jovianus. Also Maxima, Felix, Tertulla, Castulina, Gaudolus, Modianus, Justus, and Saturus. Also Saturus, Felix, Donata, Januarius, Fortunatus, and Saturninus.

Also Julia, Nina, Honoria, Donata, Calponia, Extricata, Felix, Saturninus, Donata, Ceno, Primus, Secundus, Januaria, Rogata, Faustus, Fonteius, Tertullus, Paula, and Rogata. Also Secunda, Januaria, Martialis, and Felix. Also Felix, Fortunata, Januaria, Adiutor, Fortunatus, Nomitia, Paula, Rogata, Victoria, Donatus, Mavor, Pussius, Prima, Urbanus, Tuvinus, Januarius, Sintio, Julia, Martiana, Nondinarius, Castus, Datus, Florentina, Victoria, Piscina, Castula, Saturninus, Victurianus, Fortunatus, Nina, [Col. 0461B] Nundina, Saturnina, Cecilia, Marina, Luciosa, Felicia, Maxima, Prima, Formina, Evasius, Seldinus, Tertius, Fuscus, Marcellina, Justa, Evasia, Sarmicia, Rudilia, Maria, Salpurnia, Castula, and Castulus.

Also Saturninus with 67 others; Juvinianus, Saturninus, Oratius, Latina, and Sabina; and the burial of Macellinus, Jucundus, and Julius.

In the city of Caesarea: Thamatus, Honoratus, Seleucus, Porphyrius, Pamphilus, Palestinus, and Rogata. In Campania: Herasimus, bishop. At Lyon in Gaul: 46 martyrs, namely Rogatianus the bishop, Zacharias the presbyter, Vethus, Macharius, Asclepiades, Silvius, Primus, Ulpius, Vitalis, Comminus, Octobris, Philominus, Geminus, Julia, Albina, Grata, Milianus, Potamia, Pompeia, Rodianus, Blissus, Quarta, Materna, Hilpis the deacon, Maturus, [Col. 0461C] Atbius, Alexander, Poticius, Blandinus, and Justus.

These are the ones who gave up their spirit in prison: Aristaeus, Cornelius, Zosimus, Titus, Julius, Zotichus, Apollonius, Germinianus, Julia, and Ausonia. Also Emilia, Jamnica, Pompeia, Domna, Amelia, Justa, Theophima, Antonia, and Nina. At Lyon: Vincentius, Nina, Priscus, Sepacius, Hilary, Felix, Castula, Epagathus, Amelia, and Donatus. And elsewhere: the burial of Barbarus the presbyter; Humatus, Evasius, Honorata, and Vincentia. At Rome: 48 martyrs.

### 3 June

In Africa: Quirinus, Abidianus, Gaius, Donatus, Nepor, Papozincius, Januaria, Demetria, and 147 others; Saint Juliana the virgin and martyr. At Arretium in Tuscany: Laurentius. The feast of Saint Thomas the apostle.

At Rome: Marcellus, Avidus, Gaius, Donatus, Mefomus, Passimus, Saturnus, Januarius, Victoria, Virianus, Donatus, Urbanus, Felix, Veneria, Rogatiana, Fortunatus, Extricatus, Victurina, Gorgonia, Toga, Felicitas, Valeria, Prisca, Paula, Fortunatus, Donatus, Victoria, Senereus, Cassianus, Quintus, Zetula, Victurinus, Silvanus, Gagia, Rogatianus, Aurilius, Apronius, Nabor, Quintus, Metuana, Libosus, Emeritus, Sexutus, Fructus, Severus, and Secundus.

Also Januarius, Florus, Tyturius, Donata, Januaria, Severa, Honorata, Saturninus, Victoria, Fortunata, Publius, Romanus, Peter, Verianus, and Apronius with 84 others. At Mérida: Septiminus, Saturninus, Amasius, Orasius, and Lucianus. In the city of Orléans: the burial of Saint Leifard, bishop.

### 4 June

In the city of Nevers: Zotichus, Attalus, Eutychius, Amasius, Quirinus, Julia, Saturninus, Gaddunus, Ninita, Fortunio, and 28 others; Cyprianus the bishop, Ebustus, Rusticus, and Silvius. In the city of Sabaria: Quirinus. At Rome: the feast of Saint Pietus, Aretius, and Dacianus. In Sicily: Expergentius, Christa, Italius, Philippus, Eutychius, Rusticus, Rustulus, Julia, Saturnina, Jejacon, Maena, Fortunus, Crescentia, and Jucundianus. In the city of Sabaria: Rustulus with two others.

### 5 June

In Egypt: Martianus, Nigrandus, Apollonius, Felicula, and Jocus. In Africa: Evasius and Privatus. At Rome, at the seventh milestone: Filocula, Felicitas, Pappias, Gregorius, Gaius, Rutianus, Saturninus, Rogata, Hetarius, Victurius, Mustulus, Ingenius, Secundus, Maurus, [Col. 0462B] Urbicus, Secundianus, Castula, Candida, Prima, Feliciana, Fortunata, Martialis, Julianus, Nicander, and Sacrus.

In Istria: Zolus, Saturus, Timinus, Saturnus, Servilius, Felix, Silvanus, Fortunatus, and Mammerus. At Corbie: the translation of the body of Saint Praecordius the confessor. And the burial of Saint Boniface, archbishop.

### 6 June

At Nevers: Amantius, Lucius, Alexander, Alexandria, Donata, and Peregria. The passion of the holy martyrs Vincentius the bishop and Benignus the deacon. In Africa: Zotichus, Camasius, Philippus, and Attalus. At Grenoble: the burial of Caeratus, bishop. And elsewhere: the burial of Blessed Claudius, bishop.

### 7 June

In the city of Byzantium: Paulus, Fortunatus, Marcus, Primus, and Achacius the monk. In Africa: Victurius, Evasius, Privatus, Januarius, Donata, Spissina, [Col. 0462C] and Quirillus. At Caesarea in Cappadocia: Lucianus the martyr.

### 8 June

In Egypt: the feast of Martianus and Jucundus. At Caesarea in Palestine: the feast of Eristus. In the city of Dorostorum: the feast of Saint Marcus and Lucius. At Nicomedia: Viticus, Nestor, Carolapides, and Marina. In Sardinia: the feast of Saint Phocus, Salustianus, and Silvianianus.

At Caesarea and Dorostorum: Martia, Mutiana, Heliana, Lucianus, and Zotichus. In Africa: Januaria, Donata, Spesina, and Julius. At Nicomedia: Eustilius, bishop. In Gaul, in the city of Soissons: the burial of Saint Medard, bishop and confessor. In the city of Rouen: the burial of Saint Geldard, bishop and confessor.

### 9 June

In Alexandria: Maximus the presbyter, Diomedes, Amantius, Mucianus, Alexander, and Januarius. At Rome: thirteen soldiers. In Gaul, at Pompeiacum: the passion of Saint Vincent the martyr. In the city of Nomentum: the passion of the holy martyrs Primus and Felicianus.

### 10 June

At Rome: the feast of Basilides, Auris, Rogatus, Januarius, Cassianus, Victurius, Martinus, and others. In Spain: Crispolus. At Nicomedia: the feast of Saint Zacharias the martyr. At Auxerre: the burial of Censurius, bishop.

### 11 June

At Rome: the feast of Saint Basilla and the holy Crispotus and Restitulus. And elsewhere: the translation of the body of Fortunatus, bishop. At Aquileia: Emerita, Acretius, Victorianus, and Victor.

### 12 June

At Rome: the feast of Aurilius, Lucius, five soldiers, Cirinus, Nabor, and Nazarius. At Tripoli: Macidaletes, Zabo, Aurilius, Donatella, and Secunda.

### 13 June

In Africa: Lucianus, Fortunatus, Crescentianus, and Thecla the virgin. In Persia: the feast of Saint Bartholomew the apostle. At Rome, at the seventh milestone: Feliculus, Januarius, and Silvanus.

### 14 June

In the city of Pavia: the feast of Saint Antigonus and Afer. In Africa: Quintianus, Theodolus, Festiva, Cancianilla, and Cancianus. At Aquileia: the feast of Saint Protus and Hyacinthus. In the city of Soissons: the passion of the holy martyrs Rufinus and Valerius. In the city of Orléans: the translation of the body of Saint Anianus, bishop.

### 15 June

In the city of Pavia: the feast of Saint Antigonus and Afer. In Africa: Quintianus, Theodolus, Festiva, Cancianilla, and Cancianus. At Aquileia: the feast of Saint Protus and Hyacinthus. In the city of Soissons: the passion of the holy martyrs Rufinus and Valerius. In the city of Orléans: the translation of the body of Saint Anianus, bishop.

### 16 June

At Dorostorum: the feast of Saint Ysicius, Felix, and Lupus. At Aquileia: Cantianus, Protus, and Clement. At Constantinople: the feast of Nucius, Migetia, and Minginus. In the city of Barbaria: Gaianus, Jovianus, and Philippus. In Lucania: Vitus, Candidus, Cantianus, Cantianilla, [Col. 0463B] Protus, Grisonus, Arteon, Quintianus, Theodolus, and Jucundus. In Lucania: the feast of the holy Vitus, Modestus, and Crescentia.

### 17 June

In Africa: the feast of Diogenes, Mica, Valeria, and Martia. In the city of Sicily: Saturninus and Cendeus. At Antioch: Cyricus, Julia his mother, and 400 martyrs with them. In the city of Nantes: the feast of Saint Similianus.

### 18 June

At Rome: Quiriacus, Blasius, and Nicander. At Dorostorum: Isicius, Aquila, Cantius, Cantianus, Cantianilla, and Protus. At Alexandria: Dioscorus and Marinus the martyrs. At Rome: [lacuna]ogenus. At Aquileia: Cyria, Musca, Valerianus, and Maria. In the city of Orléans: Avitus the presbyter.

### 19 June

In Africa: Martia, Emilia, and Felix. At Rome: Marcus, Marcellianus, [lacuna], Paulus, and Cyriacus. At Ravenna: the feast of the holy Martherus, Felix, Emilia, and Crispinus. In Alexandria: the feast of Saint Marina and Theon.

### 20 June

In the city of Milan: the feast of the holy Nazarius, Gervasius, Protasius, and Celsus the boy, martyrs. At Rome: Hippolytus, Honorius, Eovolus, Peter, Valeria, Marcellus, Vitalis, and Ursicinus.

### 21 June

In the city of Tomis: Paulus, Cyriacus, Paula, Felicianus, Thomas, Felix, Emilia, Vitalis, Crispinus, and Martyria.

### 22 June

Saturninus, Cyriacus, Apollinaris, Bellicus, [lacuna], Crispinus, Primus, and Januaria. In Sicily: Rufinus and Martia. At Caesarea in Cappadocia: the burial of Saint Eusebius, bishop; Hipericlus, Saturnina, Stutia, and Ineria.

### 23 June

At Antioch: Gandalicus, Julianus, Grapius, and 913 holy martyrs, whose names are recorded in the book of life. In Persia: the feast of Saint James son of Alphaeus the apostle. In Alexandria: the feast of Saint Rufus the martyr. In Britain: Albanus the martyr, with 978 others. In the city of Nola: the feast of Saint Paulinus, bishop and confessor. And elsewhere: the burial of Nicetius, of blessed memory, bishop.

### 24 June

At Nicomedia: Avitus, Cinzamus, the reader, Aritionus, Amiritus, Alicius, Capito, and [lacuna] 28 others.

### VIII Kalends of July

In the province of Palestine: the feast of Saint John the Baptist and Prophet. At Ephesus: Saint John the apostle and evangelist. At Rome: Festus and Lucia with 22 others. At Autun: the burial of Saint Simplicius, bishop.

### 7th day before the Kalends of July

At Thessalonica: Lanitanus, Thesaulonica, Bigatus, brothers, Lucia the virgin, and Auceius the king. On the same day, the feast of Vigilus the martyr and his companions.

### 6th day before the Kalends of July

At Rome: John and Paul. In Africa: Gaudentius, Felix, Agapitus, and Emerita. In Alexandria: Agatho, [lacuna], the virgin Iceia, and Diogenes.

### 5th day before the Kalends of July

At Rome, at the ninth milestone: Crispus, Crispinianus, Felix, Spinella, and seven brothers. In Spain: Crescentius, Julianus, [lacuna]inesius, Primitivus, Justinus, Tactheus, Eugenius, Novatianus, Clement, Marcellinus, Zebdinus, Felix, Hinustus, Zoenius, Marcellus, Italica, Lelius, Capito, [lacuna]inus Tuechius, and Silvanus. On the same day, the feast of the holy martyrs Justus and Clement, and Octavian the bishop. At Amiens, the discovery of the holy bodies of the martyrs Fuscianus, Victoricus, and Gentianus. On the island of Oia, the translation of the body of Saint Florentius.

### 4th day before the Kalends of July

In Africa: Sabianus, Felix, Elaphus, Venustus, Eunuchus, Crescentius, Alexander, Theon, Arion, Ploenis, Astefrius, Apollonius, Amphimonius, Philosisis, Melvius, Dionysius, [lacuna]unus, Pannus, Plebicus, Dioscorus, Tribanus, Capitulinus, Nicaea, and Gurdinus.

In Alexandria: Serenus, Theodorus, Pastusius, Titirus, Dionysina, Passimus, Plesicus, [lacuna]asta, Ambeniarius, Dioscorus, Orion, Trebanus, Capitulinus, Orion, Senerus, Plutarchus, Hereneus the bishop, Heraclius, Herotus, Potaminus, Marcellus, Basilides, Leonides, Pambon, Orio, [Col. 0464C] Panuberus, Tilina, Nonnica, Sinidi, Memmius, and Julius.

At Lyon in Gaul: Hereneus the bishop, together with six others—Leonides, Plutarchus, Serenus, Pontamina, and Marcellus. At Rome: Leo the pope.

### 3rd day before the Kalends of July

At Rome, the feast of the holy apostles Peter and Paul and of 987 other martyrs. Also, the dedication of the ancient baptistery.

### The day before the Kalends of July

At Rome, the feast of the holy Timotheus, Italica, Gelatus, Zoilus, Italica, Cursicus the presbyter, and Leo the subdeacon. At Agrippina: Asclivus and Pamphilus. At Limoges, the burial of Saint Martialis the bishop.

## The month of July has 31 days

### Kalends of July

A litany is proclaimed. At Nicomedia: Zoilus the martyr. At Rome: Gaius the pope, and the feast of the holy Lucia the virgin and Auceius the king, together with eight others. In the same city: Esicius, Processus, Marina, Antonius, Serenus, and Victor. In Mesopotamia: Zoilus with six others; Orion with eight others; and 268 others. At Antioch: Severianus, Zelius, and Epasius. On Mount Hor, the burial of Aaron the high priest. Also the burial of Primus, Idonius, and others. At Autun, the burial of the blessed Leontius the bishop. In Persia, the passion of the holy apostles Simon the Cananaean and Judas the Zealot. At Egolisma, the burial of the blessed Eparchius the bishop. At the Anisola monastery at Cinomannum, the burial of Saint Father Karilefus, presbyter and confessor.

### 6th day before the Nones of July

At Rome: Damasus, two soldiers, Processus, Martinianus, and Caelestis. Also the feast of Eutychus. Also the burial of Melchiades the pope and of Hisicus. At Amida: Amigradina, Arixus, and Jocundianilla. At Tours, Saint Monegunda.

### 5th day before the Nones of July

At Edessa in Mesopotamia, the feast and translation of the body of Saint Thomas the apostle, who suffered in India.

In Alexandria: Tryphon, Menelaus, Cyri(on), Cyril, [lacuna]forferus, Apricus, Julius, Christus, Julianus, Heraclius, Eulogius, Emerio, Cyrion, and Horestes.

At Tarsus: Severus, Helion, Straceus, Montanus, Adrianus, [lacuna]sicus, Germanus, Parthenius, and Paulus.

At Constantinople: Euphemia, Acacius, Ammon, Thomas, Tryphon, Menelaus, Cerialis, Baraclas, Eulogius, Cionia, Julianus, Demetrius, Horestes, Heliodorus, Strategius, Aminidus, [Col. 0465B] Jocundus, Martyrius, Ammius, Sustratus, Timotheus, Chionia, and Cyrianus.

### 4th day before the Nones of July

In Africa: Jocundianus, thrown into the sea, and the martyr. In Sirmium: Sabatia, Innocentius, and nineteen others. In Gaul at Tours, the ordination of the bishopric, the translation of the body of Saint Martin the bishop and confessor, and the dedication of his basilica. At Bourges, the feast of Saint Laurianus the bishop and confessor.

### 3rd day before the Nones of July

In Sicily: Agatho, Tryphon, and Justus. At Tomis: Strato, Theodotus, Merona, Rodefia, Secundus, Thomas, and Magrinus. Also Theodotus. In Alexandria, the feast of Saint Arpotis the confessor.

### The day before the Nones of July

In Alexandria: Artotus, Zetus, Pallatus, Philippus, Severus, and Julianus. In Syria: Nevedunus, Zoticus, Amandus, and Artetes. At Autun, the burial of Leontius the bishop and confessor. The burial of Saint Goar, presbyter and confessor. Also the octave of the apostles Peter and Paul.

### Nones of July

In Alexandria: Parthenius and Heraclius; Eudomon, Heleus, Apollonia, Novus, and Publicus with nineteen others. Elsewhere: Parthimius, Animas, and Pyviduius with seven others. Elsewhere: Alexander and Parthimus.

### 8th day before the Ides of July

At Nicaea: Sustratus, Sperus, and Heraclius. In Sirmium: the holy Perentius and Caecyria. At Caesarea in Cappadocia: Procopius, Quartus, and Felix. In Sicily: Prancatus. At Tauromenium: Seperus and Cornelianus with sixty others.

At Nicaea: Pladius, Emmius, Senator, Alphius, Severus, Honoratus, Eucolus, Elentius, Strato, Artemius, Eudomon, Helias, Novasius, Apolivius with eighteen others. At Heraclea: John, Aper, Anteolocus, Glieterus, Perentius, and Strato. Elsewhere: Agrestus and Primolus.

### 7th day before the Ides

At Milan: Mochus. At Tomis: the holy Zeno, Mina, Vitalis, Rufina, Evangelus, Urisius, Agnes, and Cyril the bishop, who was delivered to the fire. In Sicily: Felicianus. At Rome, the feast of the virgins Floriana, Faustina, and Anatolia, and of Fraternus the bishop.

### 6th day before the Ides of July

At Rome: Priscilla, and the feast of the seven brothers, namely Felix, Philip, Vitalis, Martial, Alexander, Silanus, and Januarius, and of four soldiers, Rufina, Secunda, Lucinus. In the Sabine territory: Anatolia and Victoria. In the city of Tomis: Martianus, Domnus, Tromedius, John, Sesinus, Aurilianis, Emilianus, and 36 others.

In Alexandria: Leontius, Mauritius, Melitius, Achilles, Daniel, Corion, Atto, Zesonus, [Col. 0466A] Eustasius, Actavius, Anicetus, Theodorus, Christus, Candidus, Gorgonius, Arcelaius, Cyrinus, Euphrodisius, Gelanus, Auticius, Azelus, Atteneus, Gagus, Sisiona, Auxentius, Valentinus, Drod itus, Faustasius, Aurelius, Gorgodianus, Cyrion, Corolus, N ostinus, Sisinna, Castrinus, and Apollonius.

At Antioch: Maximus, Rodogius, Veronica, Domnina, Maxima, Diogenes, Macharius, Timotheus, Zorcheus, Hisicius, and Moenis. In Africa: the holy Januarius, Marina, Nabor, and Felix. Elsewhere: twelve soldiers. In Armenia, at Nicopolis: Milio, Diomedes, Antonius, Aniticus, Theodulus, Cessus, Gaianus, Clericus, Sisinna, Nigdonius, Theodotus, and Cyril.

### 5th day before the Ides of July

In Africa: Marianus, Januarius, and Julianus. In Armenia, at Nicopolis: Januarius and Pelagia. At Rome: the holy Stephen, Leontius, Mauritius, [Col. 0466B] Domnus, Militonius, Achilles, Danila, Diomedes, Cyricus, Antonius, Jason, John, Eustasius, Octavius, Emilianus, Sisinnius, Anicius, Theodulus, Cessus, and Candidianus.

Also Archelaus, Gorgonius, Cyrinus, Aphrodisius, Gaianus, Clericus, Antonius, Gagus, Auxentius, Valentinus, Flavius, Nicaon, Theodorus, Faustasius, Aurelius, Gordianus, Cyrion, Cyril, Castrus, Sanctus, Eutychius, Majulus, and Silvius.

In Sirmium: Saint Martianus. At Antioch: Prodixa, Veronica, and Speciosa. In Mauretania: Martianus. In Alexandria: Eutychius. Also the blessed Benedict the abbot.

### 4th day before the Ides of July

At Aquileia: Fortunatus and Armagerus. In Sicily, the feast of Nabor, Felix, Eustasius, and Antonius. At Milan: Nabor, Felix, Primitivus, and Julius. At Caesarea: Saints Divus and Corninsus. At Lyon in Gaul, the burial of [Col. 0466C] Viventiolus the bishop.

### 3rd day before the Ides of July

In Alexandria: Serapion, Tropimeus, Meleus, Evangelus, Propolus, Attalus, Gelo, Menes the presbyter, Tropimia the virgin, and Macrobius.

### The day before the Ides of July

In Africa: Donatus. In Alexandria: Anthiotus and Marius; Dagion, Menesideus, Namor, and Petrigumnus. Elsewhere, Saint Phocas the bishop and confessor. At Lyon in Gaul, the feast of Saint Justus the bishop and confessor, and of Amicus the bishop and confessor.

### Ides of July

In Alexandria, the feast of the holy Philip, Zeno, Naseus, and ten infants. In Sirmium, the feast of the holy Agrippinus, Secundus, Maximus, Fortunatus, and Martialis.

James, bishop of Nisibis, who suffered many things in the body and performed many signs, and alone saw Noah’s ark on the mountain; no one else saw it—not even those who were with him—and they were not permitted to see it.

At the Roman harbor—that is, at Hiscla—the feast of the holy Eutropius, Zosimus, and Bonosa his sister.

In Africa, in the city of Carthage, the feast of the holy Catholinus the deacon and the remaining martyrs who rest in the basilica of Saint Fausta: Januaria, Florentius, Pullutana, Julia together, and Justa.

At the Corbie monastery, the reception of the relics of Saint Dionysius and his companions.

### 17th day before the Kalends of August

In the city of Ostia, the feast of Saint Hilarinus. At Milan, the feast of Saint Macharius. At Antioch, the feast of the holy Theodosa, Eustasius, Dionysius, Theodotus, and Maximus. At Caesarea, the feast of the holy Paul and Saint Mammes, and of Florida. Elsewhere, the feast of the holy Valentinus, Theon, and Diocletis.

### 16th day before the Kalends of August

In Africa, the feast of the holy Aquilinus, Speraea, Chindinus, Biturius, Azardus, Menelampus, and Zosimus. At Milan, the feast of Saint Marcellus, Justinus, and Nonnus. At Carthage, the feast of the holy Generosa, Januaria, and the Scillitan martyrs. Elsewhere, the feast of Saint Mamma.

In Asia: Nazarius, Veturius, Januarius, Secunda, Donata, Bessia, Maximus, Paulus, Aquilinus, Felicitas, Cutatus, Titiana, Bessa, Syriana, Entatus, and Justinus. At Auxerre, the burial of the blessed Theodosius the bishop.

### 15th day before the Kalends of August

At Rome, on the Tiburtine Way, at the ninth milestone, the feast of Saint Symphorosa, mother of seven brothers, who suffered together with them. Their names are Peter, Marcellianus, Januarius, Dionysius, Symphronius, [Col. 0467B] Clement, and Germanus; also Hireneus and Magnus.

At Dorostorum, the feast of the holy Emilianus, Bassus, Maximus, Paulus, Secunda, Donata, Marinus, and Justus. In Africa, the feast of the holy Aquilinus, Speratus, Civinus, Felix, Crescentianus, Lactatus, Nazarius, Verusa, and Generosa. Also Januarius, Titianus, Hessa, and Falvius the bishop, and Jocundus.

### 14th day before the Kalends of August

In Alexandria, the feast of Saint Sisinna. At Antioch, the holy Macharius, Lampadius, Lucianus, Philip, Peter, Torquatus, Tinninus, and Jocus. At Constantinople, the feast of Saint Daria. In Spain, the feast of Saint Justa. At Lyon in Gaul, the feast of Saint Rusticus, presbyter and confessor.

### 13th day before the Kalends of August

In Africa, the feast of the holy Sabinus, Lucianus, Peter, Amabilis, Nonna, Savo, [Col. 0467C] Agrippianus, Medatulus, and Respectatus with 23 others. In the Thebaid, the feast of Saint Victor and Silvanus. At Damascus, the feast of the holy Sabinus, [lacuna], Maximus, Julianus, Macrobius, Cassius, and Paulus with ten others.

At Corinth, the feast of the holy Cyriacus, Donatus, Tertius, Appia, Felix, Neratia, Fructus, Celsus, Theodulus, Calorus, Parthenius, Spectatus, Victor, Maximus, Pastor, Nestita, Paulus, Romanus, Valerianus, Emilius, Cassius, and Magnus.

At Rome: Passeria, Macrina, Nestita, Saturus, Amirinius, and Emilius. Elsewhere: Secundus. At the Corbie monastery, the dedication of the basilica of Blessed Stephen the protomartyr.

### 12th day before the Kalends of August

In Africa: Victor, Stercorius, Emilianus, Hugalus, Suphus, and Montanus. In the city of Caesena, the feast of the holy Adrianus, Helius, Victorius, Patroclus, Caesarianus, Adrianitis, Dimelus, Felix, Auribus, Typogratus, Faustus, Theodotus, and Julianus.

In Gaul, at the city of Marseille, the feast of the holy Victor, Alexander, Deoterius, Felicianus, and Longinus. Also the feast of Saint Praxedes the virgin.

### 11th day before the Kalends of August

The feast of the holy Cyril, Andrew, Tebellus, Aurius, [lacuna], Silvanus, and Donatus. Also at Ancyra in Galatia, the feast of Saint Plato and of the Militan martyrs: Andrew, Elianus, and Ajobosus. The burial of Wandregisilus the abbot and confessor.

### 10th day before the Kalends of August

At Rome, on the Tiburtine Way, at the nineteenth milestone, the feast of Saint Vincent the martyr.

At Ravenna, [Note: “[Col. 0467D] And ‘Militanorum’: read ‘and Militana.’”] [Col. 0468A] the feast of Saint Apollinaris.

At Laodicea in Phrygia, the feast of the holy Miniseus and Tisicus. On the Accula Way, the feast of Saint Privata and Alexandrina.

### 9th day before the Kalends of August

In the city of Amiternum, at the eighty-third milestone from the city of Rome on the Salarian Way, the feast of Saint Victorinus the martyr.

In Armenia, the feast of the holy Sabbatia, Theozonus, Victor, Militaris, Emerita with her two brothers, Statianus, Capito, Silvanus, Stercatus, Athenogina, and Dariton.

In the city of Tyre, the feast of Saint Christina the virgin.

### 8th day before the Kalends of August

The feast of Saint James the apostle. At the harbor of the city of Rome, the feast of Saint Acontius, Nonnus, James, Agatho, Donatus, and Suavis. Elsewhere, the feast of Stercorius, Clement, Julianus, Cariathon, Emeritus, Sterceus, and Suticianus.

In Sicily, in the city of Samon, the feast of Christopher the martyr. In Spain, in the city of Barcelona, the passion of Saint Cucufas the martyr.

### 7th day before the Kalends of August

At Laodicea in Phrygia, the feast of the holy Jovianus, Julianus, Emilius, Felix, Martianus, Maxima, Saturnina, Gloriosa, and Emilius. Also the feast of the holy Mutiana and Laudaia.

### 6th day before the Kalends of August

In the city of Nola, the feast of Saint Felix, concerning his ordination to the episcopate. At Nicomedia, the feast of the holy Julia, Jocunda, and Januaria. In Sicily, the feast of Saint Simon. At Auxerre, the burial of Saint Aetherius the bishop and confessor.

### 5th day before the Kalends of August

In the city of Laodicea in Phrygia, the feast of the holy Theophilus, Auxentius, Prudentius, Philip, Alexander, Zoticus, Bissia, Secunda, and Macharius.

Elsewhere, the feast of Saint Septimia, Augusta the virgin, [Col. 0468C] Celsa, and Nazarius. At Nicomedia, the feast of the holy Julia, Secunda, and Januaria. Also the feast of Pantaleon and Samson the bishop, and of Silvanus.

At Milan, the feast of the holy Gervasius, Protasius, Nazarius, and Celsus the boy. At the Corbie monastery, the dedication of the basilica of Saint Peter the apostle.

### 4th day before the Kalends of August

At Rome, on the Portuensian Way, the feast of the holy Abseodius, Rufus, Abdius, Pontianus, and Nicetius. On the Portuensian Way, at the same seventh milestone, the feast of the holy Simplicius, Faustinus, Beatrix, Magnus, and Donata.

In Africa, the feast of Felix, Nitica, Postiniana, and Philip. Elsewhere, the feast of the holy Anastasia, Philip, Saturninus, Caelestis, Patruina, Pelagia, and Jocundinus.

At Orléans, the burial of the blessed Prosper the bishop. At Troyes, the burial of Saint Lupus the bishop and confessor.

### 3rd day before the Kalends of August

In the cemetery of Pontianus, at the Painted Bear, the feast of the holy Abdon and Sennis. In Africa, the feast of the holy Maxima, Secunda, Donatella, Rufus, Priscus, Paternica, Septimia, Optio, Amon, Justus, Julia, Poatamia, Abdis, and Aceneus.

Also Maxima, Hospis, Donatula, Silvanus, and Magnilius. At Auxerre, the burial of the blessed Ursus the bishop.

### The day before the Kalends of August

In Africa, in the city of Cinnada, the feast of the holy Democritus, Secundus, Dionysius, and Thyrsus. At Auxerre, Saint Germanus the bishop and confessor. At Autun, the dedication of the older church and the translation of many holy martyrs.

## The month of August has 31 days

### Kalends of August

A litany is to be proclaimed. At Antioch, the passion of the seven holy Maccabee brothers with their mother, who suffered under King Antiochus.

At Rome, the dedication of the first church, built and consecrated by the blessed apostle Peter.

In Arabia, in the city of Philadelphia, a synod of martyrs is celebrated: the feast of the holy Cyril, Aquila, Peter, Domitian, Rufus, and Menander, crowned on the same day.

At Rome, at the thirtieth milestone from the city, the feast of the holy Secundinus, Donatula, Secundula, Maxima, Justa, Menander, [lacuna]funius, Silvanus, and Donatus.

In Italy, in the city of Vercelli, the burial of Saint Eusebius the bishop and confessor. In Spain, in the city of Girona, the feast of Saint Felix the martyr. In Gaul, in the city of Bourges, Blessed Arceladus the bishop. In the Parisian territory, at the place called Lupera, the passion of Saint Justin the martyr.

### 4th day before the Nones of August

At Rome, in the cemetery of Callistus, Saint Stephen the martyr. At Antioch, the feast of the relics of Stephen the protomartyr and deacon, who was transferred from Jerusalem following the revelation of Lucian the presbyter.

At Caesarea in Mauretania: Theodota and her seven sons. Also in Italy, in the city of Rome, the feast of Felix and Saint Nicetius. At Nicomedia, the feast of seven martyrs with their companions.

### 3rd day before the Nones of August

Saint Metropolus the bishop and Hermelus [Col. 0469C] the martyr. At Constantinople, the feast of Saint Achilles and Justus. Also the feast of Saint [lacuna]ddenis the martyr.

At Rome, the feast of the holy Drogenes and Stephen. At Jerusalem, the discovery of the body of the most blessed protomartyr, and of the holy Gamaliel, Nicodemus, and Abibon.

At Autun, the burial of Eufronius the bishop and confessor.

### The day before the Nones of August

At Rome, on the Tiburtine Way, in the cemetery, the feast of the holy martyrs Crescentiana and Justa. Also the feast of Saint Secinctus. At Nicomedia, the feast of the holy Sega and Bartholomew the martyr. At Lyon in Gaul, the arrival of the body of Saint Julius from the desert.

### Nones of August

The feast of the holy Herentius, Heraclius, and Dasius, or Bassus. At Axiopolis: Hereneus, Heraclius, and Dasius. At Rome, the dedication of the church of Saint Mary. In the city of Augsburg, the passion of Saint Afra. At Autun, the feast of Saint Cassianus the bishop. At Châlons, the feast of Saint Memmius the bishop and confessor. Elsewhere, the feast of the holy Florianus and Filistina, martyrs.

### 8th day before the Ides of August

At Rome, in the cemetery of Caelestius on the Appian Way, the feast of Sixtus the bishop, and of Felicissimus, Agapitus, Donatianus, Faustus, Praetextatus, Laurentius, Hippolytus, and 162 soldiers. Also the passion of Saint Afra.

### 7th day before the Ides of August

At Antioch, the feast of the holy Symphronius, Veneria, and seven other brothers. In Tuscany, in the city of Arezzo, the feast of Saint Donatus the bishop and confessor. At Milan, the feast of Saint Faustinus the martyr.

At Rome, the passion of 25 martyrs. In the province of Rhaetia, in the city of Augsburg, the feast of the holy Afra and Veneria.

### 6th day before the Ides of August

At Rome, the feast of the holy Secundinus, Severianus, Carpophorus, Victorinus, and Albinus.

Also on the Salarian Way: Ostensis, Crescentianus, Largus, Memmia, Juliana, Cyriacitis, Smaragdus, Secundinus, Albinus, Victurianus, Faustinus, Donata, Felix, and Silvanus.

At Nicomedia, the feast of the holy Nazarius, Juliana, and Agape the virgins, Eutychianus, Corintonus, Diomedes, Metrodora the virgin, and Justa. At Philadelphia, the feast of Saint Leonides and Agapitus.

### 5th day before the Ides of August

In the East, the feast of the holy Firmus, Rusticus, Primus, Crescentianus, Largus, Tiberianus, Amius, Tiberianus, Theodotus, Nemedianus, Laudacus, Julianus, [Col. 0470B] Polycarp, Primus, Xystus, Agathopus, and eleven others; of Felicissimus, Carpophorus, Smaragdus with nineteen others.

In Alexandria, the feast of the holy Antoninus, Onion, Tiburtinus, Valerianus, Dionysius, Felix, Eutychianus, Gagus, Melchiades, Stephen, Urbanus, Lucius, Mamon, Sactirius, Nimidius, Ladicus, Julianus, Polycarp, Magnus, and Silvanus.

At Rome, in the cemetery, the burial of Dionysius the bishop. At Cologne, the feast of the holy Virianus, Marcellinus, Secundinus, and Xystus. In the city of Limoges, Saint Martin of Brioude.

### 4th day before the Ides of August

At Rome, on the Tiburtine Way, the feast of Saint Laurence the archdeacon and martyr. On the Appian Way, Felicissimus. Elsewhere: Crescentianus, Nereus, Jacentus, Januarius, Exuperatus, Cyril, Quintus, Germanus, Geminus, Cyriacus, and Eugenius.

Also Eugenius, Pastor, Lucella, [Col. 0470C] Pontianus, Crispina, Innocentius, Terentia, Eleucippus, Sidorus, Agape, Christus, Eutychia, and Cyriaca.

Also Eleucippus with six other Innocents, who were crowned on one day. Sevius and Crescentia with thirty others, whose names are recorded in the book of life. At Ephesus, the feast of the Seven Sleepers.

### 3rd day before the Ides of August

The feast of Saint Tiburtius, and the feast of Saint Susanna. At Nicopolis, the passion of many martyrs, whose names God knows; and the passion of Saint Cassianus.

At Évreux, the feast of Saint Taurinus the bishop and confessor. At Cambrai in Gaul, the feast of Saint Gaugericus the bishop and confessor.

### 2nd day before the Ides of August

In Sicily, in the city of Catania, the feast of the holy Eupolus, Verecia, and Veneria. In Syria, in the village of Gamaratus, the holy Macharius and Julianus.

At Rome, the feast of the holy Chrysanthus and Daria, and of those who suffered with them: Claudius, Hilaria, Jason, Maurus, and 86 soldiers. In Istria, the feast of Saint Julianus with his companions.

### Ides of August

At Rome, the feast of the holy Hippolytus the martyr, Pontianus the bishop, Cornelius, Cassianus, Caelestis, and their companions.

At Synnada in Phrygia, the feast of Saint Antonius the bishop. At Lyon in Gaul, the feast of Saint Anocus the bishop. At Poitiers, the burial of Saint Radegund the queen. At Évreux, the feast of Saint Landulfus the bishop and confessor.

### 19th day before the Kalends of September

At Gindarus in Syria, the feast of Saint Fortunatus the martyr. In Africa, the feast of Saint Demetrius.

Elsewhere: Eutychius, Paulus, Heraclius, Possessor, Parmius, Dissus, [Col. 0471A] Hermes, Prospolmus, Prosalamus, Bermia, and Heraclius with three others.

At Aquileia, the feast of the holy Felix, Fortunata, and Vincentia. At Vindira in Syria, the feast of the holy Eusebius, Titulus, Conditor, Prospolmus, Castus, and Candidus. [Note: “Vindirasirus. Is there any saint of this name? Acherius indeed thought so, and mentioned Vindiratus in the Hieronymian Index; but we think quite otherwise. Since ‘the feast,’ etc. follows immediately, we see that an unskilled copyist transformed into Vindirasirus the name of a Syrian city, called here Vindira and above Gendera.”]

### 18th day before the Kalends of September

At Nicomedia, the feast of the holy Strato, Philip, and Eutychianus; and the Assumption of Saint Mary, the mother of our Lord.

### 17th day before the Kalends of September

In Alexandria, the feast of the holy Orion, Emilius, Anatus, Justinus, and Lucius. In Persia, the feast of Saint Thyrsus with his companions.

### 16th day before the Kalends of September

At Caesarea in Cappadocia, the feast of Saint Mammes the monk. At Nicomedia in Bithynia, the feast of Saint Euphemia the virgin and Macharius. In Alexandria, the feast of Saint Orion. Also Mammes, Emeldisius, Mammita with his companions, and Julianus.

### 15th day before the Kalends of September

In the city of Praeneste, at the thirty-third milestone from the city, the feast of Saint Agapitus.

Also in Pontus, in the city of Amacia [Note: “Amacia. He meant Amisina, both here and on the following day.”], the feast of the holy Pontimus, Philantia, Heliana the virgin, Martiana the virgin, and Lanciana.

In Africa, the feast of the holy Massa, Candida, Dissus, Amacia, Potomus, Martyrius, Agapitus, and Eziacus with their companions.

### 14th day before the Kalends of September

In Pontus, in the city of Amacia, the feast of the holy Philio, Rufinus, Leontius, Theodulus, Cyril, Zelasius, Timotheus, Gadda, Romulus, and Silvius.

In Alexandria, the feast of Saint Orion with his companions. At Jerusalem, the apparition of the holy cross. At Bitorivum, in the village of Vellaunus, the burial of Saint Marianus the confessor. Also the feast of Saint Magnus the martyr.

### 13th day before the Kalends of September

In Lucania, the feast of the holy Valentinus and Leontius. In Alexandria, the feast of Saint Dioscorus.

In the city of Synnada, the holy Pistarchus, Diomedes, Agathius, Zelius, Pamphilus, and Colonus the confessor.

At Turonum, in the fortress of Caino, the burial of Saint Maximus the confessor. Also the burial of Saint Philibertus.

### 12th day before the Kalends of September

In Spain, the feast of the holy Julius, Julianus, Vincentius, Augurius, and Eulodius. At the Roman harbor, the feast of Saint Hippolytus the martyr. In Sardinia, the feast of Saint Luxurius, Trajanus, Quadratus the bishop, and Primus.

In Alexandria, the feast of the holy Pistus and Sevius. Also Quadratus. At Sindofagia, the feast of the holy Arthosius, Diomedes, Zoticus, Azatangelus, and Moses.

In the province of Lucania, the feast of the holy Valentinus and Leontius. At Caballium, in the village of Mimmatus, the passion of Saint Privatus the martyr.

### 11th day before the Kalends of September

At Rome, on the Ostian Way, in its cemetery, the feast of Saint Timotheus, the disciple of Paul the apostle.

At the Roman harbor, the feast of the pilgrim martyrs, and of the holy Martialis, Aurelius, Epictetus, Saturninus, Aprilis, and Felix with their companions, Justus and Julius.

In Pontus, at Neocaesarea, the feast of the holy Nectavius and Sevius. At Antioch, the feast of Saint Marinus.

In the city of Autun, the feast of the holy Minervius [Col. 0472A] and Emilianus with eight sons, and of Saint Symphronianus the martyr.

### 10th day before the Kalends of September

At Aquileia, the feast of the holy Fortunatus, Hermogenes, Xystus, Martialis, Hermogeratus, Justus, and Geratus.

At Rome, the feast of the holy Abundantius, Innocentius, Mirerendinus, and Magnilius. At the harbor of the city of Rome, the feast of Saint Hippolytus, called Nunnus, with his companions.

At Ostia, the feast of the holy Cyriacus and Archelaus. In the province of Cilicia, the feast of the holy Agia, Claudius, Asterius, Neon, and Domninus with their companions.

At Lyon in Gaul, the feast of the holy Minervius and Eleazar with eight sons who were martyrs. At Reims, the feast of the holy Timotheus and Apollinaris. At Autun, the burial of Flavianus the bishop. At Clermont, the feast of Saint Sidonius with his companions. At Autun, [Col. 0472B] the burial of Flavianus the bishop.

### 9th day before the Kalends of September

At Antioch, the feast of the holy Zenobius, Capitolinus, Emerita, Italica, Juvianus, and Julius. In India, the feast of Saint Bartholomew the apostle. At Rome, the feast of Saint Genesius the martyr.

At Nevers, the burial of Patrick the abbot. At Rouen, the burial of Saint Audoenus the bishop and confessor. In its territory, in the village of Luperciacum, the burial of Saint Gildardus the presbyter and confessor. In the territory of that city, the burial of Saint Eptatus the presbyter and confessor.

### 8th day before the Kalends of September

In the province of Syria, the feast of Saint Julianus. At Capua, in Campania, the feast of the holy Rufinus and Eutychius with their companions. At Arles, the feast of the holy Genesius the martyr, Julius, Hermes, [Col. 0472C] and Jovianus. In Spain, the feast of the holy martyrs Justus and Pastor, brothers.

### 7th day before the Kalends of September

In the city of Salona, the feast of Saint Anastasius the martyr; in [lacuna]sia, the holy Poeclanus and Mercury the martyrs.

At Rome, in the cemetery, the feast of the holy Basilia, Maximilianus, and Quintus, martyrs. On the Praenestine Way, 25 soldiers. At Arles, the feast of the holy Sevius, Victor, and Primus. Also Victor. At Auxerre, the burial of Saint Eleutherius the bishop with his companions, the confessors.

### 6th day before the Kalends of September

At Antioch, the feast of the holy abbots Sabastus and Alexander, and of Emerita. In Lucania, in the city of Potentia, the feast of the holy Felix, Arontius, Sabinianus, and Honoratus. At Capua, the feast of the holy Rufus and Magnus.

At Rome, the feast of the holy Hermes, [Col. 0472D] and Basilia, and Julius. At Constantinople, the feast of the holy Oli and Stephen the martyr.

In the city of Tomis, the feast of the holy Marcellinus, Tribunus, and Mannis his wife, with their sons John and Serapion; also Elericus and Peter the soldier.

Elsewhere, forty martyrs who were translated from Greek into Latin. At Arles, the burial of Saint Caesarius the bishop and confessor. At Autun, the feast of Saint Syagrius the bishop.

### 5th day before the Kalends of September

At Rome, on the old Salarian Way, in the cemetery, the feast of the holy Hermes, Basileus, Elias, Stephen the deacon, and Pollio.

In Alexandria, the feast of the holy Polienus, Serapion, and Justilla. At Constantinople, the burial of Saint Alexander the bishop and Vivianus the bishop.

In the territory of the city of Clermont, in the village of Brioude, the feast of Saint Julianus the martyr. At Saintes, the burial of Saint Vivianus the bishop and confessor. In Africa, in the city of Hippo Regius, the burial of Saint Augustine the bishop and confessor.

### 4th day before the Kalends of September

The repose of Saint Elisha the prophet, disciple of Saint Elijah the prophet.

In Sirmium, the feast of Saint Basilissa the virgin. In Syrian Antioch, the feast of the holy Nicea and Paul.

At Rome, on the Ostian Way, the feast of the holy Felix, Candida the virgin, Foricia, Adausia, Gemellina with their companions. The passion of Saint Sabina the martyr.

### 3rd day before the Kalends of September

At Rome, the feast of Saint Gaudentia, the virgin, with three others. In the province of Palestine, in the city of Sebaste, the passion of Saint John the Baptist. Elsewhere, the feast of 900 martyrs who suffered on the same day.

### The day before the Kalends of September

At Trier, the burial of Saint Paul the bishop and confessor; he rested in exile.

At Ancyra in Galatia, the feast of the holy Gaianus, Lucianus, Rufinus, Vincentius, Silvanus, Vitalica, Antiquira, Emelinus, Florentinus, Justa, Julia Antinea, and Maximus. Also Vitalica.

And the burial of Saint Elladius the bishop, of Sergius, Florentinus, and their holy companions. At Auxerre, the burial of Saint Optatus the bishop and confessor.

## The month of September has 30 days

### Kalends of September

A litany is to be proclaimed.

At Capua Aquaria, the feast of Saint Priscus the martyr and Magnilis. In Tuderdana in Tuscany, the feast of the holy Terentianus the bishop, Felix, Donatus, and Silvanus. At the estate of Her, Donatus.

In Apulia, at Syracuse, the feast of the holy Evotus, Hermogenes, Caelesta, and Julianus. In Africa, in the city of Toniz, the feast of the holy Tuscia, Dubitatus, Valentius, and Donata. At Carthage, the feast of the holy Fortunatus, Donatus, and Felix.

Elsewhere, the feast of the holy Martinus the bishop, Sisinnius, and Amavis. In the city of Cinomannum, the burial of Saint Victor the bishop. At Amiens, the burial of Saint Firminus the bishop and confessor. Also of Egidius the abbot.

### 4th day before the Nones of September

At Nicomedia, the feast of the holy Zeno, Gorgonius, Monolappus, and Theodota with her sons, and of Cosconius.

In the region of Apamea, the feast of the holy Antonius and Antoninus the martyrs. At Carthage, the feast of Dubitatus, Tuscia, and Valentinus.

In Sicily, the feast of the holy Euplus, Joseph, Felix, Secundulus, and Julius. In Alexandria, the feast of Saint Theodorus the martyr. At Antioch, the feast of Saint Timotheus the martyr.

At Lyon in Gaul, the burial of Saint Justus and the dedication of the basilica of that saint. At Stavelot, Saint Remaclus the bishop and confessor. At the Corbie monastery, the dedication of the basilica of Saint Martin the pontiff.

### 3rd day before the Nones of September

In Alexandria, the feast of Saint Aristonippus. In the region of Apamea, province of Syria, [Col. 0474A] the feast of Saint Antonius the boy and Arestus the bishop.

At Aquileia, the arrival of the relics of the holy apostles Andrew and Luke, and of John the evangelist. Elsewhere, the feast of the holy Euphemia, Syricus, and Ariton with their companions.

### The day before the Nones of September

At Ancyra in Galatia, the feast of the holy Rufinus, Silvanus, Marcellus, Gaianus, Helpidius, Antoninus, Eusticus, Maximus, and Eusebius.

Also Gaianus, Vitalica, Gaison, Magnus, Castus, Saturninus, Donatus, and Eleusius with their companions.

At Rome, in the cemetery of Maximus on the Salarian Way, the burial of Boniface the bishop. At the church of Saint Felicitas, the feast of the holy Magnus, Castus, Saturninus, and Firminus.

In Gaul, in the city of Chalon, the feast of Saint Marcellus the martyr. At Trier, the burial of Saint Paulinus the bishop.

### Nones of September

At the Roman harbor, the feast of the holy Daurinus, Hero, Heralianus, and Aristos. Also the passion of the holy Thothahelus and his sister named Bebea.

At Capua in Campania, the feast of the holy Quintus, Arcon, Donatus, Magnus, and Januarius. In Alexandria, the feast of the holy Memphidis and Sturnina.

The burial of Blessed Ingenuus with his companions, whose names God knows. In Egypt, the feast of the holy Taurinus, Nemosatus, Saturninus, and Arapollonius.

In Gaul, in the city of Besançon, the feast of the holy Ferreolus and Ferrucio with their companions.

### 8th day before the Ides of September

At Rome, on the Salarian Way, at the milestone from the city, the feast of Saint Eleutherius the bishop. In the territory of Cappadocia, in the city of Readden, the feast of Saint Cottidus with his companions.

### 7th day before the Ides of September

In the city of Benevento, the feast of the holy Senotius, Januarius, Fistus, Acutus, and Desiderius. Also the passion of Saint Anastasius with his companions.

At Arles, the burial of Augustalis the bishop. At Orléans, the burial of Evortius the bishop and confessor. In the city of Autun, at the place called Alisia, the feast of Saint Regina the martyr.

In the territory of Paris, in the village of Novientum, the burial of Blessed Clodoaldus the king, later presbyter and confessor.

### 6th day before the Ides of September

The Nativity of Saint Mary, the mother of our Lord Jesus Christ, according to the flesh. Also the passion of Saint Adrian the martyr.

In Alexandria, the feast of the holy Ammonius, Justus, Serapion, and Pius. Also Pius, Theophilus, Neoterius, and 22 others; Nemesius, Arion, and Ammon.

The passion of Peter, Sabinus, Demetrius with 40 others; Didymus, Mitisorus, Panetus, Achilles, Isidore, Serapion, Magita, Oroseus, Silvanus, Arepion, and 704 others. Also Demetrius and Severus with eleven others. Also Severus with 40 others.

On that day, the gathering of the bodies of many martyrs. At Antioch, the feast of the holy Timotheus and Faustinus.

### 5th day before the Ides of September

At Rome, on the Lavican Way, between the two laurel trees, the feast of Saint Gorgonius. In the Sabine territory, at a milestone from the city, the feast of the holy Hyacinthus, Alexander, Tiburtius, Juvinus, and Silvanus.

At Caesarea in Cappadocia, the feast of the holy Donatus, Eleasius, Fortunatus, and Ammonius. Among the Parthians, the feast of the holy Mark, Libratus, and Julius.

### 4th day before the Ides of September

At Caesarea in Cappadocia, the feast of the holy Euplia, Alexander, Cirosicus, Hisicius, Alapon, and Silvanus with five others.

In Alexandria, the feast of the holy Nemesius, Ammonius, Origen, Herosus, and 806 others; Didymus, Meresorus, Panepsius, Achilles, and Nicetius.

Also Ammonius, Orosius, Silvanus, Oripion, Nimius, and Sinus, with nine others; Panemodus, Nicetius, and Silvinus.

At Rome, the burial of Blessed Hilary the pope. In Africa, the feast of the holy martyrs Doletatulus, Tuscia, Magarus, and Valentinus.

### 3rd day before the Ides of September

At Rome, on the old Salarian Way, in the cemetery of Basilla: the anniversary of Saints Protus, Hyacinth, and Didymus. At the port of the city of Rome: the anniversary of Saints Ingenuus and Hippolytus, martyrs. At Alexandria: the anniversary of Saints Syrus and Serapion. In Apulia: the anniversary [Col. 0475B] of Saints Felix, Donatus, and Julius. At Lyon in Gaul: the burial of Saint Patiens, bishop.

### The day before the Ides of September

In Sicily, in the city of Catania: the anniversary of Saints Euplus and Serapion, bishop, and Magnus. At Rome: the anniversary of Saints Protus, Sanctinus, and Hippolytus. At Nicomedia: the anniversary of Ammon, lector. In Asia: the anniversary of Saint Diophilus, Matrona, Thecla, virgin, and Heraclia. Elsewhere: the burial of Eusebius, bishop. At Lyon in Gaul: the burial of the blessed priest, bishop, and confessor. At Autun: the burial of the blessed Evantius, bishop and confessor.

### Ides of September

In Apulia: the anniversary of Saints Felicissimus and Secundinus, and Justinus. At Constantinople: the burial of Saint John, bishop. At Alexandria: the anniversary of Saint Theodulus, bishop. At Antioch: the anniversary of Saints [Col. 0475C] Timothy and Theodore. In the city of Tours: the burial of Saint Lidorius, bishop. In the city of Angers: the burial of Blessed Maurilius, bishop. At Autun: the burial of the blessed Nectarius, bishop.

### 18th day before the Kalends of October

The Exaltation of the Holy Cross. At Rome, on the Appian Way, in the cemetery of Callistus: the anniversary of Saint Cornelius, bishop and confessor. In Africa, in the city of Carthage: the anniversary of Saint Cyprian, bishop, and Felix, Honoratus, Demetrius, and Zetus. Elsewhere: the burial of Eparchius, bishop.

### 17th day before the Kalends of October

At Alexandria: the anniversary of the three holy brothers Cyrinus, Leontius, and Serapion, and of Crocus. At Ancyra in Galatia: the anniversary of Saints Seleucus and Valerius.
